full_query: If the side effects of the Prozac become too much is there a wean down period I would have to go through or would I be able to stop it immediately?

shared_context.topic: stopping Prozac because of side effects

sentences: Abrupt discontinuation of Prozac (fluoxetine), a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI), is not recommended due to the potential for withdrawal symptoms
Gradual tapering is generally advised to minimize these effects
These symptoms can include dizziness, nausea, headache, irritability, and insomnia
Medications that affect the central nervous system, such as SSRIs, should be tapered off under the guidance of a healthcare provider to avoid these withdrawal symptoms

snippets.output: Abrupt discontinuation of Prozac (fluoxetine), a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI), is not recommended because it can cause withdrawal symptoms; gradual tapering under the guidance of a healthcare provider is generally advised to minimize withdrawal symptoms, which can include dizziness, nausea, headache, irritability, and insomnia.
snippets.notes: Explicit causal chain links all four sentences: stopping abruptly may cause withdrawal symptoms, tapering is advised to minimize or avoid them, and the symptom list depends on the earlier reference to withdrawal symptoms.
